works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: A/B 测试裁决看板：深绿底大标题“SHIP THE WINNER.”，+12.4% 提升、97% 置信度直接置顶；测试卡按“上线 / 关闭 / 延长”三档拖放裁决，底部 25% 灰度放量进度一目了然；把实验结论做成一块“裁决板”，增长团队的评审会流程被压缩进一屏。
works.comment_en: A/B testing verdict board: a dark-green page headlined "SHIP THE WINNER." with a +12.4% lift and 97% confidence up top; test cards drag into ship, close or extend lanes, and a 25% staged rollout bar sits at the bottom — the whole experiment review meeting compressed into one decisive screen.
works.title: Experimentation Platform Web App Design

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 金融仪表盘 Novamint：深色底上总余额 $25,230.00 居中放大，收入 $2,436、支出 $1,359 分列两侧；右侧交易流水列出 Adobe、Walmart、Apple、PayPal、Chase，左下预算柱状图加 VISA 卡片 $1,476 收尾；深色金融仪表盘用“一个大数字 + 左右分栏”的排布，信息密度高却不乱。
works.comment_en: Novamint fintech dashboard: a dark layout with a $25,230.00 total balance front and center, income of $2,436 and expenses of $1,359 flanking it; a transaction list (Adobe, Walmart, Apple, PayPal, Chase) on the right, a budget bar chart and a $1,476 VISA card below — high information density that stays calm through one big number and clean side columns.
works.title: Finance Dashboard - Fintech Web App

works.author: Sans Design for Sans Brothers
works.comment: 披萨电商 Pize：藏青、橙红、奶油三色复古配色，大标题“A World Of Tasty Bites Awaits”，棋盘格分隔线串起整页；Pepperoni、Margherita、Hawaiian、Veggie 按口味分格陈列，配一张顾客好评卡；餐饮电商用“菜单感排版 + 实拍大图”，食欲和下单路径一次给全。
works.comment_en: Pize pizza store: a retro navy, orange and cream palette under the headline "A World Of Tasty Bites Awaits", checkerboard dividers stitching the page together; Pepperoni, Margherita, Hawaiian and Veggie laid out like a menu, plus a customer testimonial card — menu-style layout and big food photography that sell appetite and the order path at once.
works.title: Pize - Pizza e-commerce Store

works.author: Halo Product for HALO LAB
works.comment: 女性健康 App Irma：粉色渐变配剪影人像，Day 18、黄体期大字点明周期位置；Energy / Mood / Sleep 三枚标签加一根能量柱状图，症状与洞察分栏收在下半屏；健康类 App 用“一张情绪大图 + 一根数据柱”，把私密数据讲得很轻、很克制。
works.comment_en: Irma women's health app: a pink gradient with a silhouetted portrait, Day 18 and "Luteal phase" marking exactly where you are in the cycle; Energy, Mood and Sleep chips over an energy bar chart, symptoms and insights tucked below — one emotive image plus one data column that keeps intimate health data feeling light and restrained.
works.title: Mobile App for a Wellness Product ✦ Irma

works.author: Permadi Satria Dewanto for Plainthing Studio
works.comment: 空气净化器官网 Sere：白色圆柱净化器立在苔藓绿野上，大标题“A Breath of Nature”，$449 购买卡直接叠在产品图上；下方空气质量 8.0 仪表与“Three Ways to Breathe Better”分栏；家电官网用“自然摄影 + 悬浮购买卡”，把参数藏进风景、把价格留在产品旁边。
works.comment_en: Sere air-purifier site: a white cylindrical purifier standing in a mossy green landscape under "A Breath of Nature", a $449 buy card floating over the product shot; an air-quality gauge reading 8.0 and a "Three Ways to Breathe Better" section below — nature photography with the price kept beside the product, specs tucked into the scenery.
works.title: Sere — Air Purifier Product Website Design

works.author: Dipa Inhouse
works.comment: 智能戒指 Alvor 功能区：大标题“Five signals. One place they live.”，心率变异性 72ms、睡眠 7h12m、皮温 0.2°C、心率 58 BPM、血氧五张卡片并列；每张卡一句话讲清指标含义，配细线迷你图；健康硬件落地页用“五个信号、一人一数”的卡片阵列，复杂传感数据一次讲明白。
works.comment_en: Alvor smart-ring feature section: headlined "Five signals. One place they live.", five cards for heart-rate variability (72 ms), sleep stages (7 h 12 m), skin temperature (0.2 °C), heart rate (58 BPM) and blood oxygen; each card explains its metric in one line beside a thin sparkline — a card array that makes complex sensor data readable at a glance.
works.title: Alvor — Smart Ring Health Tracking Landing Page Feature Section
